dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Distinct concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a parabolic arc from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the highest point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour rising at approximately 60 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 (base width to vertical height ratio).

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a large radius forming the forehead region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Proportionally short and robust beak with visible taper toward the distal tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Intense internal cyan-turquoise luminescence localized along the dorsal ridge and melon region.
